items.description: Getting AI to write alerts is a game changer, but only if you frame it right. I’ve found that structuring your prompts with specific bullet points and strict output constraints is the secret sauce. By demanding the numbers directly, flagging missing data, and forbidding the AI from guessing causes or recommending destructive actions, you turn vague notifications into actionable intelligence. It offers insights on PSI and trends, but it stays far away from touching core settings, deleting files, or restarting my hub.
